name: git_diff
description: Show the workspace repository's changes as a unified diff. By default the unstaged working-tree changes are shown; set staged to show the changes staged for the next commit, and pass paths to limit the diff to specific workspace-relative files or directories. Read-only.

detailed: Shows the repository changes as a diff.
whimsical: Hold the changes up to the light.
{source} is comparing the before and after
{source} is laying the edits side by side

detailed: tool {participantRole} is computing the repository diff

staged.description: Optional. When true, show the changes staged for the next commit instead of the unstaged working-tree changes.

paths.description: Optional list of workspace-relative file or directory paths to limit the diff to. If omitted, the whole repository is diffed.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
